design.fit: Eight GRID development originals, ordinary recompression and global color changes. Use the largest gated ordinary chroma response plus .15, with a floor of .8. Keep the serving luminance point.
design.held: 17 retained, previously exposed neural redraws and 34 ordinary local mouth operations. Eight source-disjoint CREMA-D actors contribute independently authored local color edits and ordinary delivery controls.
design.measurement: Blur decoded Cb and Cr; remove robust corresponding-pixel global scale and shift per channel. Fit uses no face, timing label, mouth crop, or audio. Require the same broad-picture luma compatibility as serving, then select an 8/12/16/20-picture interval and expand its selected tile to a connected area.
design.gate: Union must add at least two useful timing-preserving redraw ranges in distinct source groups, including a second-family case, with >= .50 temporal and .10 middle-picture pixel IoU. Also recover six of eight color interventions, allow one extra neutral flag, and admit no wrong-source pairs. Ordinary local edits can produce the same evidence.
